newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares seen down amid NFI interest.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares seen down amid NFI interest.

text.p: Polish shares were expected to fall in profit-taking after their three-session 3.1-percent gain and high interest in National Investment Funds (NFIs), which surged in their second day of trade on Friday.

Analysts said speculative buying of the NFIs, which sent the NIF index up 6.4 percent on Friday, could begin to slow and that NFI units should extend Friday's 3.3-percent rise as their value approaches that of the funds.
Analysts said the overall market should maintain its three-month flat trend, helped by a strong economy but under pressure from the heavy primary market schedule.
